<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask settings-docs`; do not edit. -->

Settings live in `settings.toml` in the config directory (`~/.config/fauxfield` on Linux and macOS, `%APPDATA%\fauxfield` on Windows; `$FAUXFIELD_SETTINGS` overrides the path). Edit them in the Settings tab (`Cmd+,` / `Ctrl+,`) or by hand: the app watches the file, and writes keep your comments, key order and unknown keys. An invalid value becomes a Problem and the default stays in effect. A [JSON Schema](/schema/v1/settings.json) is published for editors.

## Appearance

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `theme.mode` | `"system"` | Follow the OS (system) or pin light or dark. |
| `theme.light` | `"One Light"` | Theme used in light mode. |
| `theme.dark` | `"One Dark"` | Theme used in dark mode. |
| `ui_font_family` | `"IBM Plex Sans"` | Font for the interface. |
| `ui_font_size` | `13` | Interface text size in points. |
| `buffer_font_family` | `"IBM Plex Mono"` | Font for editors and tables. |
| `buffer_font_size` | `14` | Editor text size in points. |
| `ui_scale` | `1.0` | Scale the whole interface, 0.8 to 2.0. |

## Editor

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `editor.tab_size` | `2` | Spaces per indent level, 1 to 16. |
| `editor.hard_tabs` | `false` | Indent with tab characters. |
| `editor.soft_wrap` | `false` | Wrap long lines. |
| `editor.show_whitespace` | `"none"` | none, selection or all. |
| `editor.indent_guides` | `true` | Draw vertical indent guides. |
| `editor.line_numbers` | `true` | Show the line number gutter. |
| `editor.auto_close` | `true` | Insert the closing bracket or quote. |
| `editor.cursor_blink` | `true` | Blink the text cursor. |
| `editor.format_json_on_save` | `false` | Pretty-print valid JSON bodies when saving. |

## Servers & Engine

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `autosave_delay_ms` | `300` | Milliseconds to wait after an edit before writing the file. |
| `confirm_on_quit_with_running_servers` | `true` | Ask before quitting while Servers run. |
| `restore_workspaces_on_start` | `true` | Reopen the Workspaces of the last session. |

## MCP & Agents

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `mcp.transport` | `"stdio"` | Default for `fauxfield mcp`; flags win. Applies to new sessions. |
| `mcp.allow` | `["read", "write", "execute"]` | Tool classes agents may call. Applies to new sessions. |
| `mcp.socket` | `unset` | Unix socket path for the unix transport. Applies to new sessions. |

## Traffic

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `traffic.max_rows` | `100000` | Recordings kept in memory. Applies to new sessions. |

## Keymap

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `vim_list_navigation` | `false` | j/k, g g/G, h/l in lists, trees and tables. |

## Accessibility

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `reduce_motion` | `"system"` | system follows the OS. |
| `high_contrast` | `false` | Use stronger borders and text colours. |

## Advanced

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `telemetry` | `false` | There is no telemetry in v1.0; the key is reserved. |
| `check_for_updates` | `false` | Once a day, ask GitHub for the latest release and show a status-bar notice when one is newer. Off by default; nothing is ever downloaded or installed. |
